messages.subject: export extract_taxonomy object
parts: Hi there, is it possible to save the output fo extract_taxonomy to a readable file? .txt? mostly interested in getting out observation Id and tax ranks.

messages.author: 565fb8e7abc16eb0
messages.subject: Re: export extract_taxonomy object
parts:
Hello!

The two tables in the object are just data.frames, so you can save them like any other table with "write.table". Something like "write.table(obj$taxon_data, sep = "\t"). Will that do what you need? If not, I can take a look at a part of your data and give some more specific suggestions. Thanks,
